projects.title: Community Fund Portal — Multi-Tier Civic Fundraising & Treasury Platform
projects.shortDescription: A specialized, enterprise-grade civic fundraising, on-ground volunteer cash POS, and multi-tier double-entry treasury custody management platform.
projects.overview: A specialized, enterprise-grade civic fundraising and treasury management web application built for a prominent regional community foundation. The platform modernizes traditional, paper-based community land acquisition and infrastructure campaigns into a transparent, real-time, tamper-resistant digital ecosystem. It handles community pledges, direct on-ground cash collections, automated official receipt issuance with high-resolution canvas/PDF rendering, and an advanced double-entry-style multi-tier treasury and custodian management ledger.
projects.problem: Traditional community fundraising campaigns (especially for high-value land acquisitions and community facility construction) face critical operational and governance bottlenecks: Information asymmetry, disconnected direct cash collections, multi-tier fund distribution dilemmas across central and unit treasuries, and manual paper receipt delays.
projects.solution: AIVSTACK architected an end-to-end, mobile-first, real-time web platform engineered with Next.js 15 (App Router), TypeScript, and Google Cloud Firestore featuring public contributor status dashboards, sub-5-second volunteer cash POS, double-entry custodian handover tracking, and an automated Canvas 2D vector PDF receipt engine.
features: Public Contributor Dashboard with dynamic pledge vs direct cash contribution tracking
Sub-5-Second Volunteer Cash POS with real-time phone number auto-suggest
Automatic sequential official receipt numbering (ER-No) and instant WhatsApp dispatch
Multi-tier treasury ledger with entity fund segregation (Central vs. Local Unit)
Custodian A-to-B handover system with mathematical conservation balance verification
Expense categorization and landowner milestone disbursement management
Automated client-side HTML5 Canvas 2D + jsPDF print-ready vector receipt generation
Strict integer paise (amountPaise) storage to eliminate floating-point calculation drift
Role-based governance with Super Admin controls and locked volunteer audit views
Live reactive sync using Firestore onSnapshot across admin POS and public progress screens

projects.title: High-Performance YouTube Media Processing Platform & PWA
projects.shortDescription: An asynchronous media extraction platform and PWA pairing React 19 with a non-blocking FastAPI backend, tiered FFmpeg remuxing, and headless cipher runtimes.
projects.overview: YouTube Downloader (v2.0) is an open-source, full-stack media extraction platform engineered for high reliability, zero-cloud-cost hosting, and seamless cross-platform user experience. The application pairs a React 19 + Vite Progressive Web App (PWA) with a FastAPI + FFmpeg + Python 3.12 asynchronous media processing backend. Unlike naive scrapers or ad-riddled web converters, this platform solves core distributed systems and media processing problems: preventing asynchronous event loop starvation during intensive I/O, implementing a tiered lossless FFmpeg remuxing pipeline, executing real-time download telemetry without heavy message brokers, defeating strict client-side bot/cipher challenges via headless JS runtimes, and enforcing strict ephemeral lifecycle cleanup under constrained hardware environments (512MB RAM).
projects.problem: Building a scalable, production-grade video downloader presents unique challenges that break typical web applications: asynchronous event loop starvation caused by blocking yt-dlp and FFmpeg CLI operations, 512MB RAM limits on budget container tiers, YouTube's evolving obfuscated n-sig cipher challenges, temporary disk leaks, and lack of real-time download progress feedback.
projects.solution: AIVSTACK architected an enterprise-grade async processing pipeline uniting React 19, FastAPI, Docker, and multi-runtime execution: offloading synchronous downloads to thread pools via run_in_executor with asyncio semaphore guards, implementing a 3-tier escalating lossless remuxing ladder, custom in-memory telemetry hooks polled at 300ms intervals, headless Node.js & Deno binary cipher runtimes, and dual-layer zero-leak ephemeral storage cleanup.
features: React 19 + Vite Progressive Web App (PWA) with Workbox offline caching and standalone installability
Non-blocking FastAPI backend offloading CPU-intensive tasks via run_in_executor
Concurrency bounded by asyncio.Semaphore to guarantee stable execution within 512MB RAM
Tiered FFmpeg remuxing ladder (Level 1 Stream Copy in ~1s vs Level 3 libx264 fallback)
Live download telemetry (0% to 100%) with instantaneous throughput (MiB/s) and ETA timers
Instant YouTube oEmbed metadata inspection (video thumbnail, title, author) on URL paste
Headless Node.js & Deno binary runtime containerization to solve dynamic n-sig cipher challenges
Dual-layer ephemeral storage cleanup (FileResponse hook + 10-minute automated janitor daemon)
RFC 5987 compliant UTF-8 filename delivery preserving international characters and emojis
Strict security hardening: SSRF domain whitelist, regex path sanitization, and 500MB size limits

Interactive analytics with predictive restocking forecasts
